Title: Azure Premium SSD managed disks meter ID changes

Body.Content:
Starting on November 1, 2019, the Resource GUIDs (also known as Meter IDs) for snapshots of Azure Premium SSD managed disks will change.

This won’t change pricing, but you’ll need to modify billing routines that rely on these Resource GUIDs:
